categories.main_business_segments: Shanxi C&Y Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the pharmaceutical industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of pharmaceuticals and health foods. Its main products include anti-infective drugs, anti-allergy drugs, urinary system drugs, smoking cessation drugs, pediatric medicines, respiratory system drugs, antidepressants, kidney disease drugs, pharmaceutical raw materials and intermediates, as well as health foods and medical health services such as medical diagnostics and gene preservation. The company also engages in commercial services related to the pharmaceutical sector.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies adhering strictly to GMP standards, ensuring quality control from raw material procurement to production and distribution. It has a professional R&D team and innovation system, focusing on generic drug consistency evaluation and new drug development, including high-end pharmaceutical products and precision medicine. The production follows a sales-driven plan, with marketing forecasting guiding production schedules. The company also capitalizes on biotechnology for gene preservation and employs modern quality management and process optimization techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves hospitals, pharmacies, and healthcare institutions primarily through licensed pharmaceutical distributors and academic promotion service providers. It targets both institutional and retail markets, including hospital inpatient and outpatient sectors, OTC markets, and online platforms such as JD Pharmacy. Key customers include medical institutions and commercial pharmaceutical distributors across China. The company also provides gene preservation and medical diagnostic services to healthcare providers and consumers.
categories.geographic_coverage: Shanxi C&Y Pharmaceutical Group operates mainly within China, with significant sales in regions including Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest China. The company has subsidiaries and production bases in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Shanghai, Tibet, and Shanxi provinces. Overseas sales are minimal, accounting for a very small portion of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain. It is involved in pharmaceutical manufacturing (including raw materials and intermediates), product development, and distribution through a network of distributors to hospitals and pharmacies. It also provides medical diagnostic and gene preservation services, positioning itself as a comprehensive pharmaceutical and healthcare service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on high-end pharmaceutical manufacturing, precision medicine, and health foods. It emphasizes R&D innovation, particularly in generic drug consistency evaluation and new drug development, including controlled substances and innovative drugs. The company invests heavily in expanding its R&D capabilities, establishing a dedicated pharmaceutical research institute, and pursuing clinical collaborations to accelerate product development. It also aims to optimize product structure and enhance marketing channels to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pharmaceutical products, health foods, and medical health services. The company sells drugs mainly via distributors to hospitals and pharmacies, with some direct sales for raw materials and services. It also earns income from gene preservation and medical diagnostic services. Government subsidies and investment income contribute to non-operating revenue but are not the main revenue sources.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a mid-sized pharmaceutical group with a diversified product portfolio and a focus on high-end generics and precision medicine. It competes in a highly regulated and competitive Chinese pharmaceutical market, leveraging its R&D capabilities, product quality, and broad marketing network to maintain and grow its market share. The company also benefits from government policies supporting innovation and quality improvement in the pharmaceutical sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 846.6 million, a 5.92% increase over the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 42.19 million, a 67.45% increase. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.55 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders at RMB 343 million. It has shown a positive growth trajectory with improving profitability and cash flow, supported by increased government subsidies and operational efficiencies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its commitment to high-quality pharmaceutical manufacturing, strict adherence to GMP standards, and a diversified product portfolio covering multiple therapeutic areas. It differentiates itself through its integrated approach combining pharmaceutical production, precision medicine, and health foods, supported by strong R&D capabilities and innovation. The company also highlights its comprehensive marketing network and academic promotion efforts, ensuring broad market coverage and brand recognition. Its focus on innovation, quality control, and compliance with regulatory standards underpins its competitive advantage.
